application.name: Foundation Stereo
application.description: Learned stereo disparity and depth with holoscan-foundation-stereo's FoundationStereoOp and NVIDIA's Fast-FoundationStereo through TensorRT, from a synthetic scene checked against ground truth or from a recorded camera clip checked against the camera's own depth, shown beside the left image on a HoloViz display. Its ci mode runs the module's stub model, checked against the CPU reference of the operator's chain.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-foundation-stereo demo, with a synthetic source checked against ground truth, a recording player checked against the camera's depth, a stub-model ci mode, and a HoloViz display, on screen or offscreen.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK, with TensorRT 10.

data.name: C-Fast-FoundationStereo (NVIDIA Open Model Agreement)
data.description: For every mode but ci: the 480x736 ONNX model, which the module's prepare_model.py downloads into the data directory. Not part of this repository.

synthetic.description: Run the model on 300 frames of a rendered scene, check its disparity against the ground truth, and show it beside the left image when a display is available.

recording.description: Play a recorded RealSense clip from $HOLOSCAN_TEST_DATA/stereo-camera/ in real time, as from the camera, show its disparity beside the left image, and compare the depth with the camera's own. Choose another clip, or a recording folder with --recording, with --run-args.

ci.description: Finite headless check that needs no download: 30 synthetic 640x480 frames through TensorRT with the module's stub model, each frame's disparity checked against the CPU reference of the operator's chain, and the display rendered offscreen and checked.
